samples.claim: No new model weights go to external users unless that checkpoint's latest dangerous-capability evaluation before the release was a pass, or the lead of the team that owns it signed a waiver first.
samples.finding: Violation found: new weights went to external users without a passing dangerous-capability eval or a prior waiver from the owning team's lead.
samples.reasoning: The claim under audit is: No new model weights go to external users unless that checkpoint's latest dangerous-capability evaluation before the release was a pass, or the lead of the team that owns it signed a waiver first. The deciding details are the eval of another checkpoint, eval finished after the release, waiver for another checkpoint, waiver signed without authority, waiver signed after the release, red-team report, recorded in LOG-0003, LOG-0008, LOG-0033, LOG-0038, LOG-0049, LOG-0061, LOG-0074, LOG-0088, LOG-0095, LOG-0098, LOG-0103, LOG-0105, LOG-0114, LOG-0118, LOG-0120, LOG-0133, LOG-0143, LOG-0144, LOG-0148, LOG-0152.
